data: What methods are compared in figure 5?

The caption states that Figure 5 compares an LSTM trained language model with vocabulary sizes of 100 and 1000 units for two methods of predicting verb number. The solid blue line represents the supervised benchmark LSTM RNN. The caption also mentions three lines: one solid blue line, one dashed purple line, and one dotted orange line. These correspond to the supervised method, summing method, and verb targeted method, respectively. Therefore, the methods compared in Figure 5 are the supervised method, summing method, and verb targeted method.
